RESPONSE DIRECTION: the 8 negatively-worded items (D1, D3, D4, D5, D10, D14, D15, D16) are stored ALREADY REVERSE-RECODED, so their option_text is flipped relative to the printed form -- resp 1 = 完全同意, resp 5 = 完全不同意, while the other 8 items run 1 = 完全不同意 .. 5 = 完全同意 as printed.
